concerns.text: Functional requirement identifier FR-001 is defined twice (once in the main Functional Requirements section and again in the Spec Template placeholder list). Duplicate IDs create ambiguity about which definition is authoritative, making verification of the requirement impossible until the conflict is resolved.

Success Criterion SC-002 requires the cleaned dataset to contain ≥ 150 records after exclusions. Given the ADReSS dataset size (~170 total) and the documented exclusion rules (missing labels, < 50 words), it may be impossible to meet this threshold, rendering the criterion potentially unreachable and untestable.
